content: For a self-hosted Node daemon with low job throughput (hours-long jobs, concurrency default 1), a DB-backed lease queue in SQLite beats BullMQ+Redis: BullMQ's value is cross-host queue scaling and Redis ops you already run. Adding Redis solely for jobs is real operational surface for OSS users installing the tool. node:sqlite is Release Candidate (Stability 1.2) on Node 24+ and compiled into the binary (no node-gyp); better-sqlite3 (13.0.3) remains the hardened pick with .transaction(), UDFs, and safe-integer control. Bunqueue is Bun-only, not applicable to Node. pg-boss (12.27.0) is the Postgres equivalent if Postgres is already the store.
